statement: AMD's 10-Q risk factors state that a small number of customers will continue to account for a substantial part of its revenue.
why: When a handful of buyers carry most of the revenue, a single budget pause at one of them can swing the whole accelerator demand picture.

impact.mechanism: Concentrated buyer base means demand is fragile to individual customer decisions, raising downside risk to accelerator orders.

evidence.excerpt: a small number of customers will continue to account for a substantial part of AMD's revenue
